subject: how to change the color scheme when drawing a heatmap

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: how to change the color scheme when drawing a heatmap
parts:
Hi there, I use ggstructure to draw the heatmap by using the following code:

> library(ggplot2)
> m=matrix(rnorm(100), ncol=10)
> m=as.data.frame(m)
> ggstructure(m)

and I wonder how to change the color scheme. I read the manual and know that there was only two parameters, and the parameter *scale* maybe for this purpose. but I don't know how to change its value.

anyone give me some hints?

Thanks!



--
Best regards,
Guangchuang Yu

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: how to change the color scheme when drawing a heatmap
parts:
Hi Guangchuang,

You can override the default colour scale by adding on a different scale:

ggstructure(m) + scale_fill_continuous(low = "black", high = "green")

Hadley
